Sasha: Heads-up: vendor from VerdantCo dropping off a small crate + ficus at ~11:45. Can we stage and print a temp badge? :truck: :seedling:
FrontDeskBot: Delivery logged: 1x crate (VerdantCo), 1x plant (recipient: Jules). Placed at Receiving C. Temp badge color: mint.
Ibrahim: Receiving C works. If the crate is bulky Facilities can meet at 11:40.
Jules: I'll meet at concierge and escort. Also can someone reserve the armchair by the window 11:40-12:05? Quick poll: react :thumbsup: to hold it.
Ibrahim: :thumbsup:
Sasha: :thumbsup:
FrontDeskBot: Visitor checklist updated: ID scan, mint sticker, visitor log. Crate flagged: fragile.
Jules: Thanks — I'll bring a mat for the plant. See you at concierge.
Sasha: Cool, I'll note "fragile / escort Jules" on the crate and message Facilities.
_meta: short slack thread coordinating vendor dropoff, temporary badging, plant/crate staging, and seating reservation
